newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CHEMAPOL AGM AGREES NIL DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CHEMAPOL AGM AGREES NIL DIVIDEND.

text.p: The Czech chemicals and trading conglomerate Chemapol a.s. said on Thursday that shareholders voted to pay no dividend on 1996 earnings after paying no dividend on the previous year's profit.
"The general meeting approved the annual close of accounting for 1996 and decided on the distribution of profit... in the ammount of 29.25 million crowns," Petrov said in a statement.
Asked by Reuters if that meant no dividend was approved, Petrov said: "Dividends will not be paid."
He did not elaborate on what would be done with the distributed profit.
He added that the general meetings, as expected, approved its long-held plan to place 40,000 common shares of stock for public trading with a nominal value of 1,000 crowns.
The stock would come from 20,000 shares originally set aside as employee shares with a nominal value of 2,000 crowns each.
